accounting.title: Accounting
accounting.subtitle: Who holds the cash, who is owed what, and what has actually been paid
accounting.loadError: Could not load the accounting figures.

overview.costDataIncompleteWarning: {{count}} order(s) were valued without a cost price on at least one line. Those orders balance, but the goods cost was counted as zero and the whole retail value was split as margin — so the supermarket was underpaid and the platform owners overpaid. Add cost prices to the affected products, then record a financial adjustment for each order.

balances.empty: No entitlements have been recorded yet.
balances.referenceRequired: Enter a reference so a repeated payout can be refused.
balances.invalidAmount: Enter an amount greater than zero.
balances.exceedsBalance: The amount is more than is owed ({{amount}} ₪). If that is intended, record it as an adjustment, not a payout.
balances.negative: Negative balance: this party owes the platform.

cash.empty: No driver has collected any cash yet.
cash.discrepancyNoteRequired: Say why the counted amount differs from what was expected.
cash.selectOrders: Leave the orders unticked to settle oldest first, or tick specific ones.
cash.partialHint: If less is counted than expected, only what the money covers is settled; the rest stays with the driver.

costs.empty: No operating costs have been reported.
costs.approveBody: {{amount}} ₪ will be split between the parties at the current rates and written to the ledger. It cannot be edited afterwards.
costs.rejectBody: Write the reason; it is shown to the store.

rates.note: A rate changes by publishing a new version. An order keeps the rates it was taken under, for good.
rates.publishIntro: The fields start from the rates in force; change only what you need. The new version applies to orders delivered after its effective date and changes nothing already computed.
rates.driverShareLabel: Driver's share of the delivery fee (%)
rates.remainderWeights: Split of the rest of the delivery fee (weights)
rates.confirmBody: It will apply to orders delivered after {{date}}. A published version cannot be edited or deleted. Changes: {{changes}}.

errors.notAfterCurrent: The effective date must be after the current version's start, or the new version would never be used.
errors.invalidPercent: Enter a percentage from 0 to 100 with at most two decimals.
errors.marginSplitTotal: The three margin shares must total exactly 100%.
errors.costSplitTotal: The three cost shares must total exactly 100%.
errors.commissionWeightsZero: The two commission weights cannot both be zero.
errors.deliveryWeightsZero: The three delivery-remainder weights cannot all be zero.

history.limit: Only the most recent payouts are shown.

adjustments.title: Financial adjustment
adjustments.intro: The ledger is never edited or deleted. When a number is wrong, record a new adjustment that states why and who made it; the original record stays as it was.
adjustments.noPermission: You do not have permission to record financial adjustments.
adjustments.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Driver charged for a failed delivery after CCTV review
adjustments.orderNotFound: This order has no financial record. Only delivered and failed orders produce one.
adjustments.entriesHint: "Credit" increases what the party is owed and "charge" reduces it. To move money between two parties, charge one and credit the other the same amount.
adjustments.balanced: Nets to zero — moves money between parties without creating any.
adjustments.unbalancedWarning: This adjustment nets to {{amount}} ₪, not zero: it creates or removes that amount, and the overview's ledger check will read out of balance by it afterwards.
adjustments.confirmUnbalanced: I understand and want to record it although it does not balance.
adjustments.confirmBody: Once recorded it cannot be edited or deleted (the ledger is protected against edits). To undo it, record an opposite adjustment.

errors.partyRequired: Choose the party on every entry.
errors.invalidAmount: Enter a positive amount with at most two decimals; the direction sets the sign.
errors.duplicateParty: The same party appears on more than one entry. Combine them into one.
errors.unbalancedNeedsConfirmation: The adjustment does not net to zero. Confirm that is intended, or change the entries.

subscriptions.title: Generate monthly subscriptions
subscriptions.intro: Raises the month's subscription for every approved, non-promotional restaurant. Safe to re-run: an already-billed month is skipped.
subscriptions.confirmBody: A subscription charge will be recorded for every approved restaurant not yet billed for this month, and cannot be deleted afterwards.
subscriptions.invalidPeriod: Choose a valid year and month (1–12).
